evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies net_processing, txdownloadman, txrequest, and txorphanage to fix transaction relay and orphan handling edge cases.
rationale: Plugs multiple liveness vulnerabilities in 1-parent-1-child package relay where adversarial peers can prevent honest fee-bump packages from entering the mempool. As noted in commit 65b48ba1f1, an announcer disconnecting before orphan reconsideration previously left orphans unretried while preventing other announcers from refetching them, allowing peers to intentionally delay CPFP relay.
